```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=7, fig.height=4, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(scspill)
data(cali_tobacco)
str(cali_tobacco)

W <- cali_tobacco$W      # 行正規化隣接行列 (N x N)
w <- cali_tobacco$w      # treated(=CA)への結合度ベクトル (長さN)
panel <- cali_tobacco$panel  # 列: unit, time, y
```

```{r}
fit <- sc_spillover(panel, treated_unit = "CA", T0 = 18, w = w, W = W,
                    M = 2000, burn = 1000, seed = 1, verbose = FALSE)
summary(fit)
```

```{r fig1b}
plot(fit, type = "treated")
```

```{r fig2}
idx_LA <- which(fit$inputs$units$controls == "LA")
plot(fit, type = "spillover", unit_index = idx_LA)
```
